title: Investigate Windows test process containment and TermAl ownership
outcome: Investigate Windows test process containment and TermAl ownership
acceptance: The holder's report identifies the actual TermAl process-launch paths relevant to agent-run tests, with source locations and limitations.

The holder's report separates measured Windows job behavior from hypotheses, describes safe reproducible probe evidence, and explains how the proposed ownership handles launcher death and setup failure.
The report recommends a bounded TermAl or launcher design against the supplied requirements and explicitly lists unresolved constraints without claiming production implementation.

completion.summary: Delivered containment investigation report and isolated probe evidence in target/tmp/containment-investigation-8780/report.txt; mapped TermAl ownership, measured packaged PowerShell escape and policy tradeoff, recommended bounded host-runner design with unresolved production guarantees explicit. Independent evaluation passed all three research criteria. TermAl coordinator preserved report and JSON evidence; production implementation remains parked.
